description: Use this when the user wants to stop one of their Tenda watches, by the watchId that watch_tenders or list_watches gave. It finds nothing new after that; what it already found still shows in get_tender_updates. Needs a Tenda account. Example: {"watch_id":"wch_abc123"}

watch_id.description: The watch to stop, by the id watch_tenders or list_watches gave.

name: stop_watch
title: Stop a watch
